topic: Medical tourism for skin care: 2,011,822 foreign patients in 2025 (first time over 2M, MOHW 2026-04-24), dermatology 62.9% (1.313M), top countries China, Japan, Taiwan, US, Thailand; Rejuran salmon-DNA skin booster; Gangnam/Myeongdong clinics; cosmetic VAT refund for foreigners 2016 to end of 2025 (1.72M refunds in 2024), bill to revive; telemedicine for foreign patients from next year
title: In Korea, Tourists Line Up at Skin Clinics

slides.kicker: SHOPPING BAGS. AND A SKIN CHART.
slides.headline: In Korea, tourists line up at **skin clinics.**
slides.note: Two million patients came from abroad last year.

slides.headline: **Two million** patients
slides.body: In 2025, about 2 million patients came to Korea from abroad for medical care. It was the first time the count passed 2 million, more than triple the 2023 total.

slides.headline: From **201 countries**
slides.body: China sent the most, then Japan, Taiwan, the US and Thailand. Patients came from 201 countries in all.

slides.headline: The famous one: **salmon DNA**
slides.body: Rejuran (리쥬란) is a skin booster made from salmon DNA, injected into the skin with tiny needles. Visitors call it the salmon shot.

slides.headline: Clinic **streets**
slides.body: In Gangnam and Myeongdong, a single tower can hold several skin clinics. Many have staff who speak Chinese, Japanese or English, and you book through an app.

slides.headline: A tax refund **that ended**
slides.body: From 2016, foreigners got the VAT back on cosmetic procedures. There were 1.72 million refunds in 2024. The refund ended in 2025, and lawmakers want it back.

slides.headline: Next: the **follow-up call**
slides.body: Korea plans to let foreign patients see their doctor by video from next year. A check-up can happen after the flight home.

slides.headline: Foreign patients who came **for skin**
slides.body: About 1.31 million people in 2025. Plastic surgery was next, at 11%.

slides.headline: A glow, **or a risk?**
slides.body: Doctors remind visitors that an injection is still a medical procedure. Pick a clinic registered to treat foreign patients, and leave a few days before the flight.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: A bright, minimal skin clinic treatment room, blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, a skin clinic is now a tourist stop. About 2 million patients came from abroad last year, and six in ten came for their skin.

The most famous treatment is made from salmon DNA.

Would you book one on a trip to Korea?
reply: One more thing: Rejuran comes from salmon, so if you have a fish allergy, tell the clinic first. What would you try in Korea?
fact_check: 2장: 2025년 외국인 환자 2,011,822명, 2009년 집계 이후 처음 200만 돌파. 2023년 약 61만명(보건복지부 2026-04-24, 헤럴드경제·데일리팜).
3장: 국적 순위 중국·일본·대만·미국·태국, 201개국(SBS Biz, 복지부 발표).
4장: 리쥬란 = 연어 DNA 유래 PN 스킨부스터, 외국인 선호 시술(위키트리, 강남언니 시술 안내).
5장: 강남·명동 피부과 다지점, 외국어 상담(리베리의원 등 병원 안내, 얼루어코리아).
6장: 미용성형 부가세 환급 2016년 시행, 2024년 172만1,095건, 2025년 말 일몰, 이달희 의원 2029년까지 재도입 법안(뉴시스 2025-09-23, MTN 2026-08-14).
7장: 외국인 환자 비대면 진료 내년부터 허용(데일리팜, 의료해외진출법 개정).
9장: 일반 안전 안내. 외국인환자 유치 의료기관 등록제(의료해외진출법 제6조).
